=== docker-compose-ai.yml ===
services:
  ##################################################################################
  ##                        Open WebIU Ollama                                     ##
  ##################################################################################
  webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:${VERSION_WEBUI:-ollama}
    # last tested and working on 2025-11-27
    # ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui@sha256:d3522d4f5c36de75266dfb1cda6b1ece565d5b074b3287f7de36b99328444e7f
    ports:
      - ${OPEN_WEBUI_PORT}:8080
    environment:
      ENV: dev # to see informative logs in container
      WEBUI_SECRET_KEY: ${WEBUI_SECRET_KEY}

      # --- TruSpace Signup Settings ---
      ENABLE_SIGNUP: "true"                  # TruSpace kann Admin per signup anlegen
      ENABLE_PERSISTENT_CONFIG: "false"      # ← WICHTIG: umgeht PersistentConfig-Falle
      DEFAULT_USER_ROLE: "admin"             # erster Signup wird direkt Admin
      WEBUI_AUTH: "true"

      # --- TruSpace Admin Settings ---
      WEBUI_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_USER_EMAIL}
      WEBUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD}
      ADMIN_USER_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_USER_EMAIL}
      ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD}
      SPACE_ID: "truspace"
      SPACE_HOST: "localhost"

      # -- Ollama Model Settings ---
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: http://localhost:11434
      ENABLE_WEBSOCKET_SUPPORT: "false"
      CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN: ${OI_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN}
      GLOBAL_LOG_LEVEL: DEBUG

    volumes:
      - ./volumes/open-webui:/app/backend/data
      - ./volumes/ollama:/root/.ollama/models
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
=== enabled services in .env / start.sh ===
# AI model for document analysis (https://ollama.com/search)
OLLAMA_MODEL=gemma3:1b
# 🌐 Allowed CORS origins for Open WebUI (semicolon-separated)
VERSION_WEBUI=0.10.2-ollama
DISABLE_ALL_AI_FUNCTIONALITY=false
MALWARE_SCANNING_ENABLED=false
DISABLE_ALL_AI_FUNCTIONALITY=false
# Auto-download the Ollama model if it is absent from the Docker volume
# Open WebUI backend address (internal Docker service URL)
OPENWEBUI_HOST=http://webui:8080
# 🖥️ Open WebUI — AI Admin Interface
WEBUI_SECRET_KEY=c28ef598ebdde81146e73d17027c288614a0eedb1d2007a9fca857840f1535d5
OPEN_WEBUI_PORT=3333
=== start.sh service list ===
129:  # processes (docker compose, `npm run dev` for --local-frontend, etc.)
171:  "./volumes/ollama"
172:  "./volumes/open-webui"
245:  skip_containers+=(webui)
248:  pull_containers+=(webui)
291:  docker compose $DOCKER_BUILD_OR_PULL_DOWN --remove-orphans
302:    docker compose --env-file "$SCRIPT_DIR/.env" \
309:docker compose --env-file "$SCRIPT_DIR/.env" \
311:    -f docker-compose.build.yml up -d "${pull_containers[@]}" "${build_containers[@]}"

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== docker-compose-ai.yml ===" && cat docker-compose-ai.yml; echo "=== enabled services in .env / start.sh ==="; grep -iE "ollama|webui|AI_|ENABLE" .env | head -20; echo "=== start.sh service list ==="; grep -n "ollama\|webui\|up -d\|COMPOSE_FILES\|docker compose" start.sh | head -30
